extDescription.message: Check the store you're on before you pay: VoirCheck says Safe, Hold or Block. Check only: it never pays and never reads the page.
extDescription.description: Store listing and chrome://extensions description, at most 132 characters

checkNote.message: Opens VoirCheck in a new tab and checks this store: looks safe, a bit off, or looks fake. Signed out? Sign in, then press Check.
checkNote.description: Under the button when the tab is a store page

notAStore.message: Open a store page first. VoirCheck checks web shops, not browser pages or files.
notAStore.description: When the tab can't be checked

checkOnly.message: Check only: this never pays and never reads the page.

howLink.description: Footer link to the how-it-works page

savedNone.description: No saved result from the last 3 days

savedUnavailable.message: No saved result right now. You can still check it.
savedUnavailable.description: The lookup failed or was rate-limited

savedCheckedOn.description: Before the date of the saved result, e.g. 'Checked 10 Nov'
